verses.text: Ha winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winh. Ay pax 32 heb' winh rey junnhej ix yutej sb'a yet' winh yet' pax schej heb' winh yet' scarruaje heb' winh yik owal. Ix jawi heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Samaria, ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix yak'ankot schekab' heb' winh t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha winhaj Ben-adad ix honh chekankot ul kala':
Wik yaj masanil ha b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum te wach' yet' heb' uninal te wach', xchikot winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.
Ix yalanb'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winh icha tik: Mamin rey, ujokab' icha ix al chi'. Ha hin tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ayin ikokab'i, xchib'at winh.

Ix jaxpax heb' chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalanxi heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej winhaj Ben-adad yalanxikoti: Toxo ix walb'at t'ayach to wik yaj masanil ha b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum yet' pax heb' uninal.

Hanhejtona' yab' icha tik k'ik'an, swak'anb'at heb' yajalil heb' hin soldado yik sb'at yilan heb' masanil tas ay t'a yol ha palacio yet' yoltak spat heb' winh ayoch yajalil het'ok. Masanil tas ol snib'ej heb', ol yik'kot heb', xchi winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yawtankot masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --¿Tas tz'aj he na'an ha hex tik? Ha winhaj Ben-adad chi' wannhej sayan winh tas ol yutej honh yixtani, wach'chom ha hin tik toxo ix wal t'a winh to syal wak'an hin b'eyumal, heb' ix wetb'eyum yet' heb' wuninal t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb' ichamtak winak chi' yet' masanil heb' chonhab': --Mamin rey, manh ha cha ab' tas syalkot winh chi' t'ayach, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi' t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi': --Alek t'a winh rey wajal chi', ol hin k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix yal winh t'a sb'ab'elal, palta haxo tas syalkot winh t'ayin tikne'ik, manhxo ol hin k'anab'ajejlaj, xchib'at winh. Icha chi' ix aj yalanxik'och heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Ix schekanxikot heb' schekab' winh chi' jun'elxo t'a winhaj rey Acab chi', ix yalankot winh: A'okab' juntzanh Dios tz'ak'anoch hin yahelal tato max hin satel Samaria chi' t'a jun'elnhej. Manh ol yab'laj sk'alemal yik syik'ankot jun jopok yik junjun heb' hin soldado, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxib'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: Manh smojok syik'cha'anh sb'a junok mach to wanto sb'at t'a owal, icha junok mach to wanxo sjaxi, xchib'at winh.

Wan yuk'an anh winhaj Ben-adad chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ayek' yet' winh t'a scampamento ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal heb' chekab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado to syak' lista sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal yet' jun chonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'an lista sb'a heb'.

Yakb'an chi', ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Scham wal ilan jantak heb' ajk'o'ol chi', palta ol wak'och heb' t'a yol ha k'ab' t'a jun k'u tik, yik wach' ol ojtakejeli to ha hinton Jehová Dios hin, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi', ¿mach yuj ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol hin k'ab' chi'? xchi winh. --Ha Jehová ix halani to ha yuj heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yoltak ha makb'en tik, ha yuj heb' winh ol ak' ganar, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. --¿Palta mach ol b'ab'laj yamanoch owal chi'? xchi winhaj Acab chi'. --Ha extoni, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej 232 heb' winh kelemtak chi' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix smolb'anpax heb' soldado winh ayek' ta', uke' mil heb' t'a smasanil.

Chimk'uhalil wal ix el heb', b'ab'el sb'at heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj heb', haxo winhaj Ben-adad yet' 32 heb' winh rey ajun yet'ok, hanheja' yuk'an anh heb' winh t'a yol scampamento. Ayik ix alji t'a winh yuj heb' soldado ayel yila' to ay juntzanh winak ix el t'a yol chonhab' Samaria,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Wach'chom t'a junk'olal ix elul heb', ma owal jun, yamek heb', pitzan heb' tzeyik'ankot heb' t'ayin t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ha heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' yik Israel chi', b'ab'el heb' winh, tzak'anoch masanil heb' soldado yuj heb' winh.

Junjun heb' ix milancham junjun heb' sirio ajk'o'ol chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' sirio chi' elelal, haxo heb' israel ix b'at t'a spatik heb'. Haxo winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh schej yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado, ix b'atkan heb' elelal.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' sirio chi' yuj heb' israel chi', ix yik'ankan nok' chej heb' yet' carruaje yik owal. Te niwan heb' sirio chi' ix chami.

Ixlajwi chi' ix jax winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tikne'ik scham wal ha na'ani tas tzutej ak'anoch stz'akub' heb' winh ha soldado tik, yujto ha t'a junxo ab'il yab' icha tik, sjax heb' sirio tik yak' owal et' jun'elxo, xchi winh.

Hanheja' ix yalanpax heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado sirio chi' t'a winh sreyal chi' icha tik: --Ha juntzanh sdiosal heb' israel chi', sdiosal jolomtak witz. Yuj chi', ix honh yak' ganar heb'. Palta tato ha t'a panhkiltak skak' owal yet' heb', skak' ganar heb'.
Mamin rey, ha tas tza k'ulej tikne'ik to maxtzak ak'och heb' winh rey tik yajalilok heb' soldado, say sk'exul heb' winh.

Tzak'anpaxoch heb' soldado icha sb'isul heb' ix ak'ji ganar chi', lajan tz'aj sb'isul heb' yet' nok' chej yet' pax carruaje. Slajwi chi' tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' israel t'a lum panhkiltak chi', ol kilan b'i'an tato manh ol kak' ganar heb', xchi heb'. Ix scha'an yab' winhaj Ben-adad tas ix yal heb' chi'.
Ayik ix ek' jun ab'il chi', ix yak'an lista heb' soldado winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix jawi heb' t'a chonhab' Afec yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'.

Hanhejtona' ix yak'anpax lista sb'a heb' winh soldado israel chi', ix ak'ji syamk'ab' heb' yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Ix b'at heb' israel chi', ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi'. Lajan wal yilji heb' icha chab'ok makte'al nok' chiwa, haxo pax heb' soldado yik heb' sirio chi' jun, majnakel sat lum ak'lik chi' yuj heb'.

Ha wal ta' ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Yujto ha heb' sirio tik ix halani to ha hin tik sDiosal hin lum jolomtak witz, manh hin sDiosalok lum panhkiltak, yuj chi' ha tikne'ik ol wak'och juntzanh tzijtumal anima tik t'a yol ha k'ab', icha wal chi' ol aj ojtakaneli to ha hin ton Jehová Dios hin, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Uke' k'uhal tonhej ix ajek' heb' soldado sirio t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel chi', ix lajwi chi' ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' 100 mil soldado yik heb' sirio chi' sb'ey t'a yok ix cham yuj heb' israel chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' soldado chi', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a chonhab' Afec. Haxo smuro'al jun chonhab' chi' ix kot lanhnaj t'a yib'anh heb', 27 mil heb' soldado ix el chi' ix chami. Ix pax lemnaj winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'och winh t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzuli tz'ek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yoltak pat.

Yuj chi' haxo heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh ix halan t'ay icha tik: --Ix kab'i to ha heb' winh sreyal Israel ay yok'elk'olal heb' winh, yuj chi' komonok scha ha k'o'ol skak'och pichul ya swa'i, skak'anoch lasu t'a ko jaj. Slajwi chi' b'at ko ch'oxan ko b'a t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', talaj tz'ok' sk'o'ol winh t'ayonh, manh ol honh smilchamlaj winh, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'anoch pichul heb' ya swa'i, ix yak'anoch lasu heb' t'a sjaj, ix b'at heb' sch'ox sb'a t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan heb': --Mamin rey, ha winh ha chekab' aj Ben-adad, tzonh schekkot winh kal t'ayach, komonok tz'ok' ha k'o'ol max ha milchamlaj winh, xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tom pitzanto winh jun? Ha t'a hin sat, icha wuk'tak yaj winh, xchi winh.

Te wach' ix yal winh rey chi' ix yab' heb', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha winh uk'tak aj Ben-adad chi' pitzanto winh, xchi heb'. --B'at ik'ekkot winh an, xchi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Ben-adad chi' t'a yichanh winh, ix yak'ank'e winh winh t'a yol scarruaje.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ha juntzanh chonhab' yik'nak ek' winh hin mam t'a winh ha mam, swak'xikan t'ayach. Syal sb'at heb' ha chonhwajum t'a Damasco icha sk'ulejnak heb' schonhwajum winh hin mam chi' t'a Samaria, xchi winh. --Tato icha chi', ol hach wak'el t'a libre, xchi winhaj Acab chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sb'o'an jun strato heb' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix pax winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Palta ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh schekab' Jehová, ha Jehová ix halan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a jun winh yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ak' hin echnaj hin k'ana', xchi winh. Palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh yetb'eyum winh chi'.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yujto maj ha k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ayik ol hach el t'a hin tz'ey tik, ay jun nok' choj ol hach milanchamok, xchi winh. Ayik ix el winh chi' t'a stz'ey winh schekab' Dios chi', haxo t'a yol b'e ix elta jun nok' choj t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schalan sb'a winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' junxo winh winak, ix yalanxi winh t'a winh icha tik: Ak' hin echnajok, xchi winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix mak'an winh schekab' Dios chi', ix lajwi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi' smaklej winh rey t'a yol b'e. Ix sk'exanel sb'a winh, ix smusan sat winh t'a jun k'apak.

Ayik wan yek'b'at winh rey chi' ta', te cha'anh ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi': --Mamin rey, ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, ix hin b'at t'a owal. Ha t'a skal heb' soldado ix elta jun winh soldado ix yik'ankot jun winh ajk'o'ol winh t'ayin. Ix yalan winh t'ayin to tzin tanhwej jun winh chi'. Ix cham wal yalan winh tato swaktejel winh ajk'o'ol chi', ha hinxo tzin cham sk'exulok winh, mato yowalil swak' oxe'ok arroba k'e'en plata.

Palta mamin rey, ha hin tik yakb'an ay jab'ok tas wan hin k'ulani, ix el lemnaj winh ajk'o'ol chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi': --Munil ha hach ix alk'eta ha mul yet' tas ol elul t'a ib'anh yuj, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel smusil sat winh schekab' Dios chi'. Haxo ix yilan winh rey chi' to ha jun winh chi' ha junok heb' winh schekab' Dios.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha hach tik ix aktejb'at jun winh winak ix wala' to yowalil schami, yuj chi' ha hach ol hach cham sk'exulok winh, haxo ha chonhab' ol satel sk'exulok yik winh, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj Acab chi' t'a Samaria, ix chab'axk'e sk'o'ol winh. Wan schichon sk'o'ol winh ix ochkan winh t'a yol spalacio.
